about_the_game:
Master of Cladia is a dark fantasy turn-based strategy game where you play as a powerful and mysterious alchemist. Explore the decaying lands of Cladia, command fearsome dragons, and forge deadly alchemical formulas to dominate cities, creatures, and rival alchemists.

In a world on the brink of collapse, ancient rituals and lost knowledge are the key to ultimate power. Your goal: reassemble the talisman and become the true master of Cladia. To do so, you must gather the talisman fragments scattered across the continent... or simply destroy everyone else.

Key Features

  • 🐉 Lead Your Dragons to Glory
    Hatch, command, and empower your dragons to conquer cities, plunder riches, and dominate the world of Etheria.

  • 🧪 Master the Art of Alchemy
    Combine rare components, experiment with powerful formulas, and unleash devastating effects on your enemies.

  • 🏰 Conquer and Rule
    Capture and tax cities, control their resources, and crush rebellions as you tighten your grip on the land.

  • ⚔️ Epic Tactical Battles
    Engage in classic turn-based battles with an old-school tactical feel inspired by legendary strategy games.

  • 🌐 Multiplayer Mode
    Challenge your friends or rival alchemists in multiplayer matches. Outsmart, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents in an unforgiving world.

  • 🌑 A World of Decay and Darkness
    Immerse yourself in the dark, decaying world of Etheria—a place of ancient magic, forgotten ruins, and fragile alliances.

  • ⏳ Asynchronous Multiplayer Mode

Play online with friends asynchronously: make your move in minutes, disconnect, and continue when all players have finished their turn. No need to stay online to enjoy epic turn-based matches.
